text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My first three years with Neo Universe were truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her race record was impressive, but above all,
we were able to keep her going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reborn Neo Universe
continued to run, unchanged, even after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with Zenno Rob Roy and Sweep Tosho.
However, among them...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What a shame, Uni-san.
To miss out on racing against last year's Derby Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're right. She conquered both the NHK Mile Cup
and the Derby—she was such an incredible girl!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry.
Zenno Rob Roy, Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even if she can't run... I'll be with her.
She is—running.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "We" have the "Culvert."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Another river flowing beneath the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Autumn of that year—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's a Triple Crown Umamusume!
A new Triple Crown Umamusume is born right here!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is this late-charge the second coming of Mr. C.B.!?
Or something entirely different...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Isn't she amazing, Uni-san! That Umamusume!
Her running style...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Saying something like this might show
a lack of awareness on my part, but..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but admire it a little.
It's truly incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I kind of... look up to that...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The appearance of the "singularity" went as expected.
And yet, as I feared...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's a little different from what I thought.
Neither the "Great King" nor the "Singularity"...
can stand in Zenno Rob Roy's way.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Companions" who inspire and push each other forward...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If that is the case—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Uni-san?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wonders.
Is "I"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: For what purpose—into this universe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Christmas Eve. The day before the Arima Kinen, spent relaxing together with Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Zenno Rob Roy and Tap Dance City
are also running tomorrow.
And—this year's Triple Crown Umamusume too."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Win...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, must Neo Universe win?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If I win, will I be able to feel 'content'?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Then, even if I win the 'STDA'...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "If I win in a universe without Trainer, does it become 'satisfaction'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I hesitated on how to answer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: So... that's what happened...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: So Neo Universe is... in this universe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand what she's saying.
However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe wishes to—
Share the true 'galactic core'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Today is... Christmas Eve.
...Close your eyes.
Just like that Christmas back then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I close my eyes as instructed.
Against my forehead... I felt something cold make contact.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: To the place where all universes—connect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wasâan unfamiliar place.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This place is... neither here nor there,
but a place where here, there, and everywhere are integrated...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the "bottom of gravity."
Neo Universe is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I finally understand.
Coming to your universe... no...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: To the reason our universe was born.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Right. Will you listen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I felt Neo Universe's tone changed slightly.
Her high intellect remains the same, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though complicated words had vanished.
Perhaps in this space, thoughts are transmitted directly.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I'd always thought...
Yes...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
She said she came here
to prevent herself from disappearing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And to make sure Zenno Rob Roy
wouldn't be all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Except that wasn't true. Zenno Rob Roy
can connect with others even without me around...”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Fighting" isn't the reason. I didn't come here to race, nor to pass down a legacy.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
For some other Umamusume, that's what matters most.
However—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I'm not. I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I... didn't come here to win.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I will simply—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I only wanted to "spend time with you."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you said this to me:
"The one I loved the most."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, so much time was lost.
I just wanted... to keep that time going."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to be there.
Whether I could run or not, with you."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A wish that will never come true.
Yet, knowing that—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"They" lent me their strength.
Because I couldn't accomplish it alone.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You, who wanted to see me, and I, who wanted to see you.
The window connected us.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, even if we can never meet again,
there is just one thing—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because in this universe, we can meet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Time loses all meaning. The world loses all meaning.
Every boundary vanishes, merging into one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Countless Neo Universes become one.
Countless selves become one.
And then—she feels it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That without a doubt,
"I loved Neo Universe."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Instinct and hatred cannot transcend dimensions. What can transcend them is—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Only ‘love.’ Love alone transcends it.
It will let me surpass it.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, our goal isn't just victory.
It's aiming for victory *together*...”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: And—this universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A new universe—
where you and I can be together forever.
